notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped ordinary object-deletion surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies timestamped deletion and removal delivery, object identity boundaries, queued deletion retraction, time-role servicing, invalid-object failures, and lifecycle cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped object-deletion and retraction services with FederateAmbassador timestamped removal and retraction callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador timestamped object declarations
